question: The Bay of Bengal’s islands of Andaman in the north and the Nicobar in the south are separated by a waterbody which is called the ________ channel.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ten degree.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• **Ten degree** is a channel that separates the **Andaman Islands** and **Nicobar Islands** from each other in **Bay of Bengal**. 
 
• The two sets of Islands together form the **Indian Union Territory (UT) **and **Andaman and Nicobar Islands.**
 
• This channel is **150 km** wide from north to south and approximately **10 km **long from east to west.
 
• It has minimum depth of** 7.3 m **and lies from east to west on the** 10 degree line of latitude north of the equator.**
